day_shape: 62 items: CENTCOM says US blockade has redirected 99 commercial vessels, rial hits 2.3m/dollar, Houthis advance on Bab el-Mandeb, OFAC publishes Iran GLs CC and DD, three McMurdock PQs on Iran sanctions.

threads.label: US blockade and Iran economic strain
threads.summary: CENTCOM said US forces have redirected 99 commercial vessels enforcing the blockade against Iran as of 11 September, while the Jerusalem Post reported the rial dropped to 2.3 million per dollar. IRIB claimed the Tehran stock index set a record at 7,278,000 points and the Central Bank flagged 300 trillion tomans in suspicious transactions.

threads.label: Houthi Red Sea advance and Saudi pipeline
threads.summary: Iran International reported Houthi forces advanced toward Bab el-Mandeb, reaching Dhubab as Yemeni forces withdrew from Perim Island, while drones from Iraq struck Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline. Defa Press and the IRGC spokesman celebrated Ansarallah's gains; the Jerusalem Post cited an Al Akhbar report that Netanyahu signalled Israel could join a regional campaign against the Houthis.

threads.label: OFAC licences and UK sanctions questions
threads.summary: OFAC published Iran-related General Licenses CC and DD in the Federal Register alongside Venezuela GLs 30B, 50A, 51 and 51A. Independent MP James McMurdock tabled three written questions to the FCDO on the 8 September Iran Sanctions Written Ministerial Statement.

threads.label: Israel operations in Gaza and Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF said it killed Hamas Rafah Brigade sniper-cell commander Moamen Jabr Al-Sayed Abu Labda in a Khan Younis strike and released footage of destroying Hezbollah tunnels on the Ali al-Taher ridge. IRIB claimed a separate Israeli drone strike in al-Mawassi wounded four; Iran International reported Iranian hardliners urging escalation in response.

threads.label: Iran-linked AI misuse flagged by Anthropic
threads.summary: Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post reported that Anthropic blocked Iran-linked actors using its AI models to target US naval forces, profile Israeli and Jewish diaspora organisations and expand surveillance inside Iran. The report also cited an apparent Houthi effort to use the models to help build guided missiles.

threads.label: Iran internal politics and unrest
threads.summary: Iran International reported heavy fighting in Saravan with dozens of security personnel killed or wounded per Haalvsh, and a hardline bid to remove President Pezeshkian exposing conservative rifts. The MFA spokesperson visited Lamerd and called recent incidents a crime against the nation; a Jerusalem Post interview said the regime is losing its grip.

threads.label: Pezeshkian diplomacy at BRICS
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press reported Pezeshkian met India's president and Malaysian PM Anwar Ibrahim on the sidelines of the BRICS summit in India. Defa Press framed the appearance as enhancing Iran's manoeuvring power within a shifting international balance.

events.title: A Hamas sniper commander was killed in an Israeli airstrike in the southern Gaza Strip yesterday, the military says. Thursday's strike in Khan Younis killed Moamen Jabr Al-Sayed Abu Labda, the commander of a Hamas sniper cell in the terror group's Rafah Brigade, according to the IDF. The military says Abu Labda "carried out sniper training across the Gaza Strip" in preparation for attacks, as well as tried to restore Hamas capabilities, "in systematic violation of the ceasefire."
events.summary:
A Hamas sniper commander was killed in an Israeli airstrike in the southern Gaza Strip yesterday, the military says.

Thursday's strike in Khan Younis killed Moamen Jabr Al-Sayed Abu Labda, the commander of a Hamas sniper cell in the terror group's Rafah Brigade, according to the IDF.

The military says Abu Labda "carried out sniper training across the Gaza Strip" in preparation for attacks, as well as tried to restore Hamas capabilities, "in systematic violation of the ceasefire."— Emanuel (Mannie) Fabian (@manniefabian) Sep 11, 2026
